description: Relay a Solana swap that the caller signed with their own wallet: pass request_id and the signed base64 transaction from swap_quote. This broadcasts a real on-chain swap that moves the wallet's funds; the trade includes the 0.5% DexSheet fee disclosed in the quote. Returns the execution status, signature and an explorer link. Solana only: for EVM quotes broadcast transaction_request with your own wallet. DexSheet never sees keys; it forwards the already-signed transaction to Jupiter Ultra /execute. Quotes expire in about a minute.

signedTransaction.description: The transaction from swap_quote, signed by the taker wallet, base64.

name: swap_submit
title: Submit a signed Solana swap (Jupiter Ultra)
